note: kinnim/kinnam is an uncertain insect name; ancient versions (LXX skniphes) and modern lexica favour gnats or mosquitoes rather than lice (KJV 8:16-18).
'arov means "swarm/mixture"; the KJV supplies "of flies" (after the LXX "dog-fly"), but the creature is not specified (KJV 8:21-31).

kjv: the LORD in the midst of the earth
mine: Yahweh in the midst of the land
note: ha'arets here most naturally means the land of Egypt, where Yahweh shows he is active, not the whole earth (KJV 8:22).
The Masoretic text reads pedut "redemption/ransom"; the KJV "division" follows the LXX/Vulgate sense (perhaps reading pelut "separation") (KJV 8:23).
